name: wa-housing-homelessness
what_it_holds: R analysis of rising rent costs vs homelessness in Washington State 2015-2024, built on Zillow ZORI and HUD Point-in-Time (PIT) homelessness counts. Pushed 17 Jul 2026.
why_useful: Rare multi-year (2015-2024) state-level panel combining ZORI with an independent HUD series; the underlying merged CSV, if committed, would be a decadal WA rent time series.
themes: Long-term rent indices: Zillow ZORI/ZHVI downloaders, Apartment List, Redfin data center, Realtor.com, HUD Fair Market Rents, Census ACS rent, CoStar-like
Housing affordability and STR-housing studies data: rent-burden, vacancy, STR share of housing stock by tract
why_all: Rare multi-year (2015-2024) state-level panel combining ZORI with an independent HUD series; the underlying merged CSV, if committed, would be a decadal WA rent time series.

State-level, decade-long (2015-2024) rent-burden/housing-stress panel built from two public sources (ZORI + HUD PIT); marginal for ABNB directly but is a real multi-year time series construction pattern for rent-cost pressure that could proxy long-term-rental cost competition against STR conversion incentives.

name: rightmove_webscraper.py
what_it_holds: Python class returning up to 1,050 live Rightmove.co.uk listings (price, property type, address, bedrooms, postcode, agent) per search as a pandas DataFrame. No committed dataset. MIT license, 282 stars, 119 forks, 83 commits. Repo itself flags that Rightmove's ToS prohibits scraping.
why_useful: Turnkey method for pulling UK long-term-rental/for-sale asking prices by postcode/region — useful as a UK housing-cost comparator or host-economics proxy.
themes: Rental listing scrapers and datasets (Craigslist, Zillow rentals, Apartments.com, Idealista, Rightmove, Zoopla, Immoscout24, SeLoger, Immobiliare, Domain, realestate.com.au)
why_all: Turnkey method for pulling UK long-term-rental/for-sale asking prices by postcode/region — useful as a UK housing-cost comparator or host-economics proxy.

Simple one-command live pull of UK asking rents/sale prices by postcode/region for LTR supply-economics work (gap 13); ToS caveat means any use is a human terms-of-service call per repo CLAUDE.md rule 6.
